title: TC060-Create a new issue from the top nav Create button
description: Verifies that clicking Create in the top nav opens the issue creation dialog and successfully creates an issue.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:3000
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3000")
        
        # -> Click the 'Go to Jira' button in the page header to enter the Jira application.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/header/div/div[2]/a').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Navigate to /projects/SCRUM/board and wait for the board to load.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/projects/SCRUM/board")
        
        # -> Click the left part of the top-nav 'Create' split button to open the issue creation dialog (the button labeled 'Create').
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/header/div[2]/div/button').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Open the 'Space' combobox so a space can be selected for the new issue.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/header/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[3]/div/button').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Select the desired Space for the new issue by clicking the 'My Scrum Project' option in the open Space combobox (index 1893).
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[3]/div[2]/div/div/div/div[3]').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Fill the Summary field with 'TestSprite Created Issue' and click the Create submit button to create the issue.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/header/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[3]/div[5]/input').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.fill('TestSprite Created Issue')
        
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/header/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[4]/div/button[2]').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # --> Test passed — verified by AI agent
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        current_url = await frame.evaluate("() => window.location.href")
        assert current_url is not None, "Test completed successfully"
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
